question: What is the standard size of basketball for men?
solution:
The correct answer is __**7**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The standard size of a basketball for men is **size 7**.
 
• Size 7 basketballs have a circumference of **29.5 inches** (75 cm) and a weight of **22 ounces** (620 grams).
